cast-first.label: Open OGS → cast → the TV becomes the launcher

marks.text: Open OGS → cast → the TV becomes the launcher
Open OGS: the first thing is the TV. Cast to a TV
Living room TV: OGS starts in the cloud and streams to it; the phone turns into the remote
First touch: the focus moves along the icon row, the whole TV becomes that game's hub

launch.label: Pick and start Rocket Crew mission 6 with the touchpad

marks.text: Pick and start Rocket Crew mission 6 with the touchpad
Click right on the glass: Word Duel's hub (your turns)
Back to Rocket Crew
Down to Continue · Mission 6 (the phone says what a click will do)
Click: who's playing. Tonight's crew is already in; Juneau's and Ava's iPads light up
Start: mission 6 in the same stream; the phone becomes the Captain controller

swap.label: In Rocket Crew → Home → Bake Shop day 4: 2 phone taps, 0 kid taps, no recast

marks.text: In Rocket Crew → Home → Bake Shop day 4: 2 phone taps, 0 kid taps, no recast
Home: Rocket Crew suspends at mission 6; the control centre slides up over it
Click: Bake Shop day 4 is already focused. Same stream, the iPads follow by name

word-duel.label: Your turn on the TV → play it on the phone

marks.text: Your turn on the TV → play it on the phone
Word Duel's hub: two turns waiting, from Nana and Mom
Down to the turn cards
Click Nana's turn: the board opens on the phone; the TV shows only the score
Play TONAL for 26 on the phone
Back to the TV: one turn left (Mom)

list.label: Browse on the phone instead: tap the list, the TV follows

marks.text: Browse on the phone instead: tap the list, the TV follows
Switch the remote to a list on the phone
Tap Bake Shop: the TV turns to its hub
Continue · Day 4: who's playing on the TV and on the phone
Start

remote-handoff.label: Jonathan's phone sleeps: Mom picks up the remote

marks.text: Jonathan's phone sleeps: Mom picks up the remote
Mom takes the remote: one tap, the TV says so

recast.label: The cast drops: cast again resumes mission 6

marks.text: The cast drops: cast again resumes mission 6
Cast again: OGS comes back at mission 6; the iPads drop back in
